name: Rea
mentions: …hern Dakota. We have never heard the right idea expressed better than by our genial Register at Bismarck, Mr. Rea. He says: “If I was running this thing I would conduct it like a church festival. Nothing to get in and five dollars to get out.”
Road-master Rea of the Northern Pacific was in Medora Tuesday. The railroad company will begin track work as soon as possible.
